The '''Stonemaul Ruins''' are the former home of the [[Stonemaul]] [[Ogre]]s. The original village was destroyed by members of [[Onyxia]]'s brood. The ogre leader, [[Overlord Mok'Morokk]] led his people away from the ruin and established a new home to the north called [[Brackenwall Village]].

The ruins are located within [[the Dragonmurk]] and are currently infested with [[Firemane]] [[Dragonspawn]].
